// Volatility Compression Release Model
// ATR: Wilder RMA via atr() — validated vs TradingView
// Predictability: efficiency ratio disp/sumAbs, 0=chop 1=directed

atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(50, "Coil Length", 10, 150, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "VoV Length", 5, 60, 1)
loadedThresh = input(0.75, "Loaded Threshold", 0.0, 1.0, 0.05)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.2, "Release Mult", 0.5, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rangeNow = high - low
highestATRCoil = highest(atrVal, coilLen)
highestRangeCoil = highest(rangeNow, coilLen)
highestATRVov = highest(atrVal, vovLen)
lowestATRVov = lowest(atrVal, vovLen)
coilATR = atrVal / max(highestATRCoil, 0.0000001)
coilRange = rangeNow / max(highestRangeCoil, 0.0000001)
loaded = 1 - (coilATR + coilRange) / 2
vov = (highestATRVov - lowestATRVov) / max(lowestATRVov, 0.0000001)
vovRising = vov > vov[1]
chg = close - close[1]
ach = abs(chg)

var sumAbs = 0.0
var li = 0
sumAbs := 0.0
li := 1
while li <= predictLen {
  sumAbs := sumAbs + ach[li]
  li := li + 1
}

disp = abs(close - close[predictLen])
predictab = disp / max(sumAbs, 0.0000001)
armed = loaded > loadedThresh and vovRising
brkHigh = highest(high, predictLen)[1]
brkLow = lowest(low, predictLen)[1]
rangeTrig = rangeNow > atrVal * releaseMult
relUpRaw = armed and rangeTrig and close > brkHigh
relDnRaw = armed and rangeTrig and close < brkLow
releaseUp = relUpRaw and not relUpRaw[1]
releaseDn = relDnRaw and not relDnRaw[1]
relRange = rangeNow / max(atrVal, 0.0000001)
coneSz = min(3.0, max(0.2, (0.8 + relRange * 0.4) * markerSize))

if armed {
  bgcolor("#332200", "main")
}
if releaseUp {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Up", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if releaseDn {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Dn", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if releaseUp {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Release Up 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", coneSz, 0, "separate")
}
if releaseDn {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Release Dn 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", coneSz, 1, "separate")
}

plot(loaded, "Loaded", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictab, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 2, "separate")
plot3d(loaded, "Loaded Coil", "scatter", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictab, "Predictability", "scatter", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vov, "VoV", "scatter", "#b48cff", "separate", 2)

momLen = input(12, "Momentum Length", 2, 50, 1)
volLen = input(20, "Volatility Length", 2, 100, 1)
volMult = input(1.5, "Volatility Multiplier", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

pastClose = close[momLen]
mom = close - pastClose
vol = stdev(close, volLen)
upper = vol * volMult
lower = 0 - vol * volMult

buySig = crossover(mom, upper)
sellSig = crossunder(mom, lower)

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

plot(mom, "Momentum", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
plot(upper, "Upper Breakout", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot(lower, "Lower Breakout", "#4488ff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(mom, "Momentum", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(upper, "Upper Level", "line3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)
plot3d(lower, "Lower Level", "line3d", "#4488ff", "separate", 2)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
m236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6% Multiplier", 0.05, 1.0, 0.001)
m382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2% Multiplier", 0.05, 1.0, 0.001)
m50 = input(0.5, "Fib 50% Multiplier", 0.05, 1.0, 0.001)
m618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8% Multiplier", 0.05, 1.0, 0.001)
show236 = input(1, "Show 23.6% Line", 0, 1, 1)
show382 = input(1, "Show 38.2% Line", 0, 1, 1)
show50 = input(1, "Show 50% Line", 0, 1, 1)
show618 = input(1, "Show 61.8% Line", 0, 1, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, lookback)
swingLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow
l236 = swingHigh - rng * m236
l382 = swingHigh - rng * m382
l50 = swingHigh - rng * m50
l618 = swingHigh - rng * m618
showAny = show236 + show382 + show50 + show618

buySig = crossover(close, l618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, l382)

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
    label.new(bar_index, l618, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, true, "center", "fibEvent")
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
    label.new(bar_index, l382, "Lost 38.2%", "#ff4477", 1, true, "center", "fibEvent")
}

plot(l236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(l382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(l50, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(l618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot3d(l236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(l382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(l50, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(l618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Length", 5, 20, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Length", 15, 50, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Length", 30, 100, 1)
skewLen = input(60, "Skew Length", 20, 120, 1)
compressThresh = input(0.7, "Compress Threshold", 0.1, 1.0, 0.05)
compressLookback = input(5, "Compress Lookback", 2, 20, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

denom = close[1] + 0.000000001
r = (close - close[1]) / denom
fastRV = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen)
medRV = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt(medLen)
slowRV = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)
hi = highest(high, skewLen)
lo = lowest(low, skewLen)
rng = hi - lo
posRaw = (close - lo) / (rng + 0.000000001)
isFlat = rng == 0
pos = posRaw
if isFlat {
    pos = 0.5
}
skew = pos - 0.5
spread = fastRV - slowRV
midSpread = fastRV - medRV
termLevel = (fastRV + medRV + slowRV) / 3
compression = fastRV < slowRV * compressThresh

var compCount = 0
if compression {
    compCount := compCount[1] + 1
} else {
    compCount := 0
}

wasCompressed = compCount[1] >= compressLookback
expansion = wasCompressed and fastRV > fastRV[1] and fastRV > slowRV * compressThresh
skewPrev = skew[1]
bullFlip = skewPrev <= 0 and skew > 0
bearFlip = skewPrev >= 0 and skew < 0
buySig = expansion and bullFlip
sellSig = expansion and bearFlip

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(spread, "Term Spread F-S", "#33ccff", 1, "line", "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#ffcc33", 1, "line", "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")
plot3d(termLevel, "Term Manifold", "manifold", "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(fastRV, "Fast Spine", "ribbon", "#ffcc33", "separate", 1)
plot3d(spread, "Spread Impulse", "bars3d", "#33ccff", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5 Strength", 0, 100, 1)
baseScale = input(1.0, "Base Scale", 0.1, 3.0, 0.1)
thickFactor = input(0.1, "Thickness Factor", 0.01, 0.5, 0.01)
buyThr = input(70, "Buy Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
sellThr = input(30, "Sell Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = (close - open) / (high - low + 0.001) * 5
c1d = max(0, min(100, ch1 + drift))
c2d = max(0, min(100, ch2 + drift))
c3d = max(0, min(100, ch3 + drift))
c4d = max(0, min(100, ch4 + drift))
c5d = max(0, min(100, ch5 + drift))

h1 = c1d * baseScale
h2 = c2d * baseScale
h3 = c3d * baseScale
h4 = c4d * baseScale
h5 = c5d * baseScale

avgA = (c1d + c2d + c3d + c4d + c5d) / 5
splineY = (h1 + h2 + h3 + h4 + h5) / 5
thickT = avgA * thickFactor
thickW = max(1, min(5, thickT))

buySig = avgA > buyThr and avgA[1] <= buyThr and c5d > c1d
sellSig = avgA < sellThr and avgA[1] >= sellThr and c5d < c1d
alertHigh = c1d == 100 or c2d == 100 or c3d == 100 or c4d == 100 or c5d == 100
alertLow = c1d == 0 or c2d == 0 or c3d == 0 or c4d == 0 or c5d == 0
alertT = thickT >= 9 or thickT <= 1
alertAny = alertHigh or alertLow or alertT

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if alertAny {
  bgcolor("#ffcc0055", "separate")
}

plot(h2, "Cyl2 H", "#ff9944", 1, "separate")
plot(h3, "Cyl3 H", "#ffdd44", 1, "separate")

plot(h5, "Cyl5 H", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(splineY, "Spline", "#4488ff", thickW, "separate")
plot(avgA, "Array Avg", "#ffffff", 2, "separate")

vxIn = input(1.0, "Wind Vector X", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
vyIn = input(0.0, "Wind Vector Y", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
vzIn = input(0.0, "Wind Vector Z", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
windSpeedIn = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minSpeed = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 50.0, 0.5)
maxSpeed = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 10.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minTail = input(1.0, "Min Tail Length", 0.2, 10.0, 0.1)
maxTail = input(5.0, "Max Tail Length", 1.0, 20.0, 0.1)
highThr = input(25.0, "High Wind Threshold", 5.0, 80.0, 0.5)
lowThr = input(5.0, "Low Wind Threshold", 0.0, 30.0, 0.5)
shiftDeg = input(30.0, "Direction Shift Deg", 5.0, 90.0, 1.0)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

priceNudge = (close - close[1]) / (close + 0.000000001)
wobble = priceNudge * 8.0
xEff = vxIn + wobble
yEff = vyIn + wobble * 0.5
zEff = vzIn + wobble * 0.25
sEff = windSpeedIn + wobble * 12.0

mMag = sqrt(xEff * xEff + yEff * yEff + zEff * zEff)
isZero = mMag < 0.000000001
dx = xEff / (mMag + 0.000000001)
dy = yEff / (mMag + 0.000000001)
dz = zEff / (mMag + 0.000000001)
dxN = isZero * 1.0 + (1.0 - isZero) * dx
dyN = (1.0 - isZero) * dy
dzN = (1.0 - isZero) * dz

yawRad = atan2(dyN, dxN)
horiz = sqrt(dxN * dxN + dyN * dyN)
pitchRad = atan2(dzN, horiz + 0.000000001)
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578
rollDeg = 0.0

sClip = min(max(sEff, minSpeed), maxSpeed)
span = maxSpeed - minSpeed + 0.000000001
speedNorm = (sClip - minSpeed) / span
tailLen = minTail + speedNorm * (maxTail - minTail)
gradT = speedNorm

arrowColor = "#2266ff"
midColor = gradT > 0.33
hotColor = gradT > 0.66
arrowColor2 = midColor * 0.0 + 0.0
coneColor = "#2266ff"
coneColorUp = gradT > 0.5
tailDyn = tailLen + priceNudge * 0.5
speedDyn = sClip + priceNudge * 2.0

buySig = speedDyn > highThr and speedDyn[1] <= highThr
sellSig = speedDyn < lowThr and speedDyn[1] >= lowThr
yawChg = abs(yawDeg - yawDeg[1])
pitchChg = abs(pitchDeg - pitchDeg[1])
shiftSig = (yawChg > shiftDeg or pitchChg > shiftDeg) and speedDyn > 15.0

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#ff8800")
    model.entry(1, "WindHigh")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#2266ff")
    model.exit("WindLow")
}
if shiftSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff8800")
}

lowCol = "#2266ff"
midCol = "#9955cc"
highCol = "#ff8800"
plotCol = gradT < 0.33 and lowCol or gradT < 0.66 and midCol or highCol
plot(speedDyn, "Wind Speed kn", "#ff8800", 2, "separate")
plot(tailDyn, "Tail Length", "#2266ff", 1, "separate")
plot(yawDeg, "Yaw Deg", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")

plot3d(speedDyn, "Wind Speed", "ribbon", "#ff8800", "separate", 0)
plot3d(tailDyn, "Tail Length", "line3d", "#2266ff", "separate", 1)

if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Wind+", "coneup", "#ff8800", 1.4, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, 0.0)
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Wind-", "conedown", "#2266ff", 1.4, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, 0.0)
}

    plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff8800", 1.0, 1, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, 0.0)
